parse_observation_sawyer_coffee_pull: parse a raw observation vector into hand position, mug position, and unused info fields
desired_pos_sawyer_coffee_pull: compute the desired end-effector position based on current hand and mug positions for pulling
grab_effort_sawyer_coffee_pull: compute the gripper grab effort based on the proximity of the hand to the mug
